description: Structured mapping from esoteric or technical current-event phenomena to academic disciplines, foundational mechanisms, scholarly databases, and common lay/media misconceptions.

evidence_hierarchy.label: Systematic Reviews, Meta-Analyses & Consensus Assessments
evidence_hierarchy.epistemic_weight: Highest empirical synthesis weight across multiple independent trials or observational cohorts.
evidence_hierarchy.agent_usage_rule: Prioritize first whenever explaining empirical effect sizes, clinical outcomes, or physical climate projections; report confidence intervals and GRADE/IPCC certainty tiers.

evidence_hierarchy.label: Peer-Reviewed Journal Articles & Replicated Empirical Studies
evidence_hierarchy.epistemic_weight: Refereed primary research; reliability scales with sample power, causal identification strategy, and independent replication.
evidence_hierarchy.agent_usage_rule: Verify DOI via Crossref, confirm non-retracted status via Retraction Watch/OpenAlex, and inspect citation context in Semantic Scholar.

evidence_hierarchy.label: Formal Engineering/Legal Standards & Peer-Reviewed Reference
evidence_hierarchy.epistemic_weight: Definitive normative authority for protocol specifications, statutory definitions, and formal conceptual boundaries.
evidence_hierarchy.agent_usage_rule: Use NIST, IETF RFCs, IEEE, WorldLII, SEP, and OWID to anchor exact technical definitions and historical baselines.

evidence_hierarchy.label: Institutional Working Papers & Empirical Policy Research
evidence_hierarchy.epistemic_weight: Credentialed scholarly analysis circulated prior to final blind journal refereeing.
evidence_hierarchy.agent_usage_rule: Label as working paper or policy brief (NBER, BIS, RePEc, SIPRI, Chatham House/Carnegie), check if a journal version exists, and note institutional perspective.

evidence_hierarchy.label: Non-Peer-Reviewed Preprints
evidence_hierarchy.epistemic_weight: Unvetted frontier manuscript; useful for understanding breaking technical claims under debate, never for settled truth.
evidence_hierarchy.agent_usage_rule: MANDATORY: Explicitly disclose 'unrefereed preprint' status (arXiv, bioRxiv/medRxiv, SSRN) and pair with peer-reviewed domain context.

concept_clusters.title: Semiconductor Lithography Physics, Packaging & Export-Control Chokepoints
academic_disciplines: Economic Statecraft & Global Value Chain Economics
foundational_mechanisms: Rayleigh resolution criterion (CD = k1 * lambda / NA): why shifting wavelength from 193nm ArF immersion DUV to 13.5nm EUV plasma light—and raising numerical aperture (High-NA 0.55)—determines feature density and multi-patterning yield.

Multi-patterning DUV vs. single-exposure EUV economics: DUV immersion CAN physically pattern 7nm-class logic via quadruple patterning (SAQP), but suffers compounding mask steps, defect density, and cost penalties.
AI compute bottlenecks beyond transistor node size: High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) stacks, CoWoS 2.5D interposer packaging, and chip-to-chip interconnect bandwidth often bind before raw FLOPS.
common_media_misconceptions: Treating 'nm' marketing node names (e.g., '3nm', '5nm') as literal physical transistor gate lengths—commercial node labels decoupled from physical gate dimensions over a decade ago.
Assuming export bans on EUV scanners make sub-7nm fabrication physically impossible rather than yield- and cost-constrained via multi-patterning DUV.
concept_clusters.pedagogical_bridge_prompt: Explain Rayleigh's optical resolution equation in plain English so the reader sees why 13.5nm EUV light requires vacuum mirrors and tin-droplet laser plasmas—and why servicing/consumables matter as much as initial scanner sales.

concept_clusters.title: Central Bank Monetary Transmission, Yield Curves & Shadow-Banking Liquidity
foundational_mechanisms: Bond price-yield inverse convexity and duration mismatch: how rising policy rates erode mark-to-market value of held-to-maturity sovereign bond portfolios on bank balance sheets.
Repo and FX swap funding plumbing: how non-bank financial intermediaries roll overnight collateralized borrowing, and how margin spirals trigger forced deleveraging.
Long and variable monetary transmission lags across fixed- vs. floating-rate mortgage/corporate debt structures.
common_media_misconceptions: Equating central bank reserve creation (QE) mechanically 1-for-1 with immediate consumer CPI inflation without examining bank credit creation, velocity, and fiscal deficits.
Assuming an inverted yield curve mechanically 'causes' recessions rather than reflecting bond-market expectations of future policy-rate cuts.
concept_clusters.pedagogical_bridge_prompt: Walk through a simplified bank or dealer balance sheet to show how overnight funding meets long-term bond duration, connecting abstract basis-point moves to real-economy borrowing costs.

concept_clusters.title: Tariff Incidence, Sanctions Evasion & General-Equilibrium Trade Mechanics
foundational_mechanisms: Statutory vs. economic tariff incidence: who actually bears a tariff depends on relative export supply and import demand elasticities plus currency exchange-rate offset.
Input-output upstream linkage penalties: tariffs on intermediate industrial inputs (steel, chemicals, PCBs) raise production costs for domestic downstream exporters.
Trade rerouting and 'lengthening supply chains': how bilateral trade restrictions reallocate flows through third-country assembly hubs with value-added rules-of-origin thresholds.
common_media_misconceptions: Treating a bilateral trade deficit with a single country as a corporate profit/loss ledger rather than an outcome of comparative specialization and national savings-investment balances.
Declaring sanctions 'total failures' because third-country transshipment occurs, ignoring transaction-cost wedges and discounted export revenues.
concept_clusters.pedagogical_bridge_prompt: Clarify statutory payer (importer of record at customs) versus economic incidence (pass-through to domestic prices vs. foreign exporter margin compression) using empirical NBER elasticity findings.

concept_clusters.title: Public International Law, IHL/LOAC & Maritime Chokepoint Regimes
academic_disciplines: International Humanitarian Law (Law of Armed Conflict)
foundational_mechanisms: ICJ procedural stages: provisional measures under Article 41 require only 'prima facie' jurisdiction and 'plausibility of rights' to prevent irreparable prejudice—years before a final evidentiary judgment on the merits.

IHL Proportionality vs. Distinction: under Additional Protocol I, legal proportionality weighs anticipated concrete military advantage against expected incidental civilian harm ex ante—NOT a post-hoc comparison of symmetric casualty ratios.

UNCLOS Strait 'Transit Passage' vs. Territorial Sea 'Innocent Passage': why coastal states legally cannot suspend transit passage through international straits connecting high seas/EEZs (Hormuz, Bab el-Mandeb, Malacca).
common_media_misconceptions: Reporting an ICJ Provisional Measures order finding 'plausible rights' as if the Court had issued a final merits conviction—or, conversely, claiming the Court ruled no violation occurred.
Confusing the International Court of Justice (state-vs-state UN organ) with the International Criminal Court (individual criminal prosecution under the Rome Statute).
concept_clusters.pedagogical_bridge_prompt: Map the exact procedural stage and treaty article at issue, distinguishing preliminary injunctions/plausibility thresholds from final merits adjudication.

concept_clusters.title: Outbreak Transmission Dynamics, Spillover & Clinical Trial Biostatistics
foundational_mechanisms: Case Fatality Ratio (CFR) vs. Infection Fatality Ratio (IFR): early outbreak surveillance detects severe hospitalized cases first while missing mild/asymptomatic infections, systematically inflating naive early CFRs until seroprevalence surveys are run.

Antigenic drift (point mutations) vs. antigenic shift (segment reassortment in co-infected hosts) and receptor-binding tropism (e.g., avian alpha-2,3 vs. human upper-respiratory alpha-2,6 sialic acid receptors).
Relative Risk Reduction (RRR) vs. Absolute Risk Reduction (ARR) and Number Needed to Treat (NNT) in clinical trials.
common_media_misconceptions: Extrapolating a historical hospitalized Case Fatality Ratio (e.g., ~50% in severe avian flu detections) directly as the population fatality rate if widespread mild transmission occurred.
Treating statistically underpowered subgroup post-hoc analyses or unrefereed medRxiv preprints as proven clinical effects.
concept_clusters.pedagogical_bridge_prompt: Illustrate the numerator/denominator iceberg comparing hospital-detected CFR against serology-based IFR, and report both absolute and relative risk metrics.

concept_clusters.title: Power Grid Stability Physics, Energy System Economics & Weather Attribution
foundational_mechanisms: Synchronous rotational inertia vs. inverter-based resources (IBRs): AC grids must maintain tight frequency (50/60 Hz); heavy rotating steam/hydro turbines provide physical kinetic buffer against sudden generator trips, whereas solar/wind inverters require grid-forming control firmware and synthetic inertia.

Plant-level LCOE vs. System-Value/Firming Cost: marginal generation cost at midday differs from 24/7 dispatchable firm power once transmission, storage duration, and seasonal dunkelflaute backup are included.

Probabilistic Extreme Event Attribution (World Weather Attribution / IPCC): comparing hazard return periods in factual (+1.3C) vs. counterfactual pre-industrial climate ensembles rather than claiming climate change 'solely caused' a single storm.
common_media_misconceptions: Blaming complex cascading grid blackouts instantaneously on 'renewables' or 'fossil plants' within hours before sequence-of-events fault logs (relay trips, voltage collapse, reactive power) are audited.
Binary claims that climate change either 'caused Storm X' or 'weather is natural' instead of reporting probabilistic likelihood/intensity multipliers.
concept_clusters.pedagogical_bridge_prompt: Explain AC grid frequency balance (generation matching load millisecond-by-millisecond) and how probabilistic attribution quantifies shifts in return-period odds.

concept_clusters.title: Internet Routing Security, Zero-Day Exploitation & Cyber Attribution
foundational_mechanisms: Vulnerability lifecycle: vulnerability discovery -> exploit chain development (bypassing ASLR/sandboxes) -> C2 infrastructure -> post-exploitation lateral movement; why a high CVSS score alone does not equal active exploitation without CISA KEV telemetry.
Control-plane trust assumptions: BGP route hijacking (lack of universal RPKI route-origin validation) and software update-signing key compromises.

Diamond Model & multi-layer cyber attribution: why IP addresses and malware strings are easily spoofed ('false flags'), whereas victimology, operational hours, infrastructure procurement, and multi-year tradecraft are harder to fake.
common_media_misconceptions: Equating low-cost DDoS website defacements with destructive operational-technology (OT/SCADA) intrusions.
Treating a language string inside malware code as proof of nation-state origin without tradecraft corroboration.
concept_clusters.pedagogical_bridge_prompt: Distinguish noisy surface disruptions (DDoS) from deep authentication/signing-chain compromises, and explain how forensic attribution layers technical telemetry with strategic victimology.

concept_clusters.title: Military Logistics, Air-Defense Cost-Exchange & Deterrence Theory
academic_disciplines: Operations Research & Military Logistics (Salvo Combat Models)
foundational_mechanisms: Salvo combat equations (Hughes) and cost-exchange / magazine-depth asymmetry: saturation strikes pit cheap mass-produced one-way munitions against scarce, multi-million-dollar radar-guided interceptors constrained by annual industrial run-rates.
Culminating point of attack and Tooth-to-Tail logistics: mechanized advances decay exponentially with supply-line distance from railheads, fuel depots, and barrel-maintenance echelons.
Deterrence by denial (making attack physically unlikely to succeed) vs. deterrence by punishment (threatening retaliatory cost), and the stability-instability paradox.
common_media_misconceptions: Focusing on single-platform 'game-changer' weapons specifications while ignoring crew training pipelines, spare-parts logistics, electronic-warfare adaptation, and interceptor stockpile replenishment.
Misunderstanding 'hypersonic': nearly all ballistic missiles travel above Mach 5 on reentry; the distinct technical challenge is endo-atmospheric sustained maneuverability (HGVs/HCMs).
concept_clusters.pedagogical_bridge_prompt: Connect tactical headline intercepts to underlying salvo math, magazine depth, and annual industrial replenishment rates.

concept_clusters.title: Survey Sampling Error, Demographic Momentum & Labor Econometrics
foundational_mechanisms: Total Survey Error vs. textbook sampling margin of error: +/- 3% assumes pure random sampling, whereas modern polling error is dominated by differential non-response, likely-voter modeling, and correlated state-level weighting errors.

Period Total Fertility Rate (TFR) vs. Completed Cohort Fertility and demographic momentum: tempo shifts (women delaying childbirth to older ages) depress period TFR more sharply than lifetime cohort fertility, while age-pyramid structure locks in workforce size 20 years ahead.
Composition effects in aggregate wage statistics: during layoffs of low-wage service workers, median reported wages of remaining employed workers artificially jump!
common_media_misconceptions: Reporting a 1-point movement between two polls as 'Candidate A surges ahead' when it sits well inside design-effect margin of error and house-effect variance.
Inferring individual household income trajectories from shifting cross-sectional medians without checking workforce composition changes.
concept_clusters.pedagogical_bridge_prompt: Unpack Total Survey Error (beyond naive +/- random sampling error) or workforce composition effects so readers interpret headline numbers without statistical whiplash.

concept_clusters.title: Judicial Standards of Review, Administrative Law & Anti-Corruption Forensics
foundational_mechanisms: Procedural vs. substantive rulings: dismissal for lack of Article III standing, ripeness, or sovereign immunity leaves the underlying legality of the challenged conduct completely undecided.
Preliminary injunction four-factor balancing test (likelihood of success on merits, irreparable harm, balance of equities, public interest) on an expedited record vs. full trial fact-finding.
Beneficial ownership layering: how nominee directors, multi-jurisdictional trusts, and free-trade-zone intermediaries separate legal title from ultimate beneficial control.
common_media_misconceptions: Reporting 'Supreme Court upholds/endorses Policy X' when the Court actually denied emergency shadow-docket relief or dismissed on narrow standing grounds.
Equating the filing of a civil complaint or grand-jury indictment (probable-cause threshold) with proven trial liability.
concept_clusters.pedagogical_bridge_prompt: Clarify the exact legal threshold met at the current docket stage (standing, probable cause, preliminary injunction, or final judgment) before discussing broader policy stakes.

concept_clusters.title: Crisis Bargaining Theory, Alliance Commitments & Secondary Sanctions Jurisdiction
foundational_mechanisms: Credible commitment problems & costly signaling (Fearon / Schelling): why verbal diplomatic assurances fail when power trajectories shift, and why binding treaties or forward troop deployments function as costly signals.

Primary vs. Secondary Sanctions & Correspondent-Banking Jurisdiction: primary sanctions bar domestic persons from trading with a target, whereas secondary sanctions threaten third-country banks with loss of U.S. dollar correspondent clearing accounts.

Alliance treaty text precision: even NATO Article 5 obligates each party to take 'such action as it deems necessary' rather than automatic mechanistic war declaration—making political cohesion as vital as legal text.
common_media_misconceptions: Describing SWIFT as a bank that holds or freezes funds—SWIFT is a financial messaging cooperative; actual asset freezes occur on commercial/central bank balance sheets.
Treating non-binding summit joint statements or Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) as legally ratified, senate/parliament-approved treaties.
concept_clusters.pedagogical_bridge_prompt: Distinguish legally binding ratified treaty obligations from political signaling, and explain correspondent-banking plumbing when covering sanctions.
